description: Rewrites supply_chain_enrichment to achieve >20 distinct scores. Current signal has 35 distinct values OK but enrichment module has only 280 rows vs 10134 registry entries (2.8% coverage). MUST read MULTIPLE metadata fields: registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars, npm_audit_flags, github_stars, license_type, maintenance_status. Bonus for publisher_verified, official registry, recent audits. Penalty for high dependency_count, known vulnerabilities, non-standard licenses. Pure compute_score(metadata) -> (float, dict) per enrichment contract. Exit 0 on self-smoke.
